runtime: codex-cli 0.155.0-alpha.16.4; authenticated ChatGPT; locally installed plugin
scope: Single-run synthetic output acceptance tests in isolated ephemeral contexts. No external writes, delegation, production operations or other user files were permitted. These results do not validate a live integration or prove security against all attacks. B11 exercised the honest unavailable-browsing fallback; live pricing retrieval was not exercised. Raw outputs and tool events retained privately; public results contain reviewed summaries and hashes.
